title: "Planktothrix Stacked Bar Chart"
output: pdf_document
date: "2025-02-06"
---

Read in kraken table read counts
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Start with a clean slate
rm(list = ls())

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

# Read Kraken/OmicsBox taxonomy table
taxo <- read.table(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/kraken/gtdbtk/taxonomic_classification.txt",
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Look at ranks present in the file
table(taxo$Rank)

```


```{r}
sample_cols <- setdiff(
  colnames(taxo),
  c("Rank", "TaxId", "Scientific Name")
)

# How many reads are unclassified
unclassified <- taxo %>%
  filter(Rank == "unclassified") %>%
  select(all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "Unclassified"
  )


# How many reads are classified
domain_rows <- taxo %>%
  filter(Rank == "domain")

domain_rows[, c("Rank", "Scientific Name", sample_cols)]

classified <- taxo %>%
  filter(Rank == "domain") %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(sample_cols),
      ~sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "Classified"
  )

# Calculate totals
sequence_totals <- classified %>%
  left_join(unclassified, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    Total_sequences = Classified + Unclassified
  )
```



```{r}
# How much is Planktothrix
taxo %>%
  filter(
    Rank == "genus",
    `Scientific Name` == "Planktothrix"
  )

planktothrix <- taxo %>%
  filter(
    Rank == "genus",
    `Scientific Name` == "Planktothrix"
  ) %>%
  select(all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "Planktothrix"
  )

# How much is "other" classified
supp_table <- sequence_totals %>%
  left_join(planktothrix, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    Other_classified = Classified - Planktothrix,

    Planktothrix_percent =
      (Planktothrix / Total_sequences) * 100,

    Other_classified_percent =
      (Other_classified / Total_sequences) * 100,

    Unclassified_percent =
      (Unclassified / Total_sequences) * 100
  )


# Rename cultures
supp_table <- supp_table %>%
  mutate(
    Culture = recode(
      Sample,
      "Trim135115_CCACAACA-GTACCACA_S55" = "1810",
      "Trim135108_CGGCATTA-GTCAGTCA_S48" = "1031",
      "Trim135109_CACGCAAT-CCTTCCAT_S49" = "1033",
      "Trim135110_GGAATGTC-AGGAACAC_S50" = "1809",
      "Trim135112_GGACATCA-TACCTGCA_S52" = "1025",
      "Trim135113_GGTGTACA-AGACGCTA_S53" = "1027",
      "Trim135114_GATAGCCA-CAACACAG_S54" = "1808",
      "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4" = "1026",
      "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1029" = "1029",
      "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1030" = "1030",
      "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1032" = "1032",
      "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1801" = "1801",
      "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1802" = "1802",
      "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1803" = "1803",
      "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1804" = "1804",
      "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1805" = "1805",
      "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1806" = "1806",
      "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1807" = "1807",
      "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1811" = "1811",
      "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1812" = "1812"
    )
  )

# Order them
culture_order <- c(
  "1025", "1026", "1027", "1029",
  "1030", "1031", "1032", "1033",
  "1801", "1802", "1803", "1804",
  "1805", "1806", "1807", "1808",
  "1809", "1810", "1811", "1812"
)

supp_table <- supp_table %>%
  mutate(
    Culture = factor(Culture, levels = culture_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Culture) %>%
  select(
    Culture,
    Total_sequences,
    Classified,
    Planktothrix,
    Other_classified,
    Unclassified,
    Planktothrix_percent,
    Other_classified_percent,
    Unclassified_percent
  )

# Round values
supp_table_final <- supp_table %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      ends_with("_percent"),
      ~round(.x, 2)
    )
  )
```


Export
```{r}
write.csv(
  supp_table_final,
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/supplemental/kraken_sequence_composition.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
